name: me.conkist.gdk.services
description: Connects a Unity game to the Conkist Platform: anonymous player session, connection codes (account link and class room, typed or by QR) and telemetry.

samples.description: One script: start a session, send telemetry, flush on pause and quit. Needs a project public key.
Two scenes: show a QR and an 8-digit code, or type a code (account or room). Needs a local Conkist API and a project public key.
